### Observed differences

- In the later window, the outgoing transitions from A21 were redistributed: the share going to A23 fell from about 31% to about 21%, and to A25 from about 27% to about 20%, while the share to A24 rose from about 17% to about 26%, to A19 from 13% to about 17%, to A17 from 3% to 7%, and to A20 from 0.5% to 1.5%. [DIR001]
- The shares to A15 and A16 were unchanged at about 5.5% and 3.5%. [DIR001]

### Inference

Support level: Insufficient evidence

The evidence is insufficient to infer a change in the process. Only one control-flow item was flagged, while about 0.3 items would be expected by chance in an unchanged process, so this single redistribution is within what random variation can produce. [DIR001]
